card.name: Small words inside noun phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as their, to, of, does, and his daughter, in the middle of a clause. They are followed by a noun that completes the phrase, in general prose and in cephalosporin hypersensitivity warnings.

modes.label: Possessive their/his
modes.description: The possessive their or his before a body part, host or family member noun.
modes.example: which use it to invade<< their>> host’s cells.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to
modes.description: The word to after 'previous hypersensitivity reactions' in a beta-lactam warning.
modes.example: careful inquiry about previous hypersensitivity reactions<< to>> other cephalosporins, pen

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A verb or preposition in the middle of a clause, where the next word is still expected.
modes.example: the power holder<< does>> not hold any bond from the ones upon
